curiosity.title: The Areni-1 Cave Shoe in Yerevan, Armenia

Made from a single piece of cowhide leather, and still with its leather laces it has been measured as corresponding to a modern US size 7 / EU size 37 / UK size 6. It is stuffed with grass to either maintain its shape or keep the foot warm.

Pensão Amor building is a former brothel that has been transformed into a surprising space in Lisbon's port district. Cais do Sodré was once the sailors’ quarter, where seamen fresh off the boats mingled with writers, fado singers, artists, prostitutes and the occasional spy.
